reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Harvey Grace: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source; the key signature (doh G) and the incipit's doh (Ab) disagree. Imported from CCEH tune 000292 (the melody read from 000292a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William Croft's dates (1678–1727) are from our page for the tune ST ANNE (content/hymns/tunes/st-anne.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1708. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000292a.nwc).
